headline: Iris Build
title: Iris Build | Vortex of Petals and Disco | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want a cheap Grass damage dealer? Build Iris around Vortex of Petals, its strongest skill at sixty power and twenty energy. Floral Storm is weaker at thirty power, but it sends out up to three homing petals while you move. Every skill hit adds Dance Power, and at twenty four your next skill is free. Iris is weak to Fire, Wind and Dark. Will you try it? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Iris build: lead with Vortex of Petals (60 power, 20 EP), use Floral Storm for homing petals and the Disco Aniimo trait for a free skill at 24 Dance Power. Weak to Fire, Wind and Dark.
